name: spec-open
moment: a lever's spec plate opens (reading what it meters)
prompt: A thin aluminium spec plate flipped open on a hinge, light metallic click and slide, close up

name: clipboard
moment: the customer's clipboard opens (reading the plans)
prompt: Paper pages flipped over on a clipboard, a crisp page turn and the metal clip snapping back

name: lever-pull
moment: a contract lever is pulled (choosing what to meter)
prompt: A heavy steel switchgear lever pulled down into its latch, metal grind then a solid clunk

name: detent
moment: commitment knob turned: one detent click per step (throttled)
prompt: Single small precise click of a machined aluminium rotary knob turning one detent, close up, tiny and dry

name: lock
moment: Lock it confirmed: the commitment is locked (the commit)
prompt: A heavy steel vault lock turning: a key switch grinding round and a big bolt sliding home, ending in a deep metallic clunk that rings briefly

name: pen
moment: reveal: each month the chart recorder pens draw the next stretch
prompt: Chart recorder pens scratching across paper while the chart drive motor whirs softly, steady mechanical scribble

name: counter
moment: reveal: each month the bill drums roll to the new total
prompt: Mechanical counter number drums rolling over quickly, a short run of metal wheel clicks

name: printer
moment: reveal: each month's line prints on the ticket printer (within commitment: this alone)
prompt: A small dot matrix receipt printer printing one line, short buzzing print head and paper feed

name: overage
moment: reveal, wrong: a month runs over the commitment and bills overage (red lamp pulses)
prompt: An industrial panel warning buzzer sounding one harsh electric buzz, control room

name: invoice
moment: end of term: the invoice is torn off and the debrief opens
prompt: A long paper receipt torn off a printer's serrated edge, one quick sharp paper rip
